JZ38 repeats the real Death program; XG17 captures typed marker/aura entry evidence. Damage is not classified as an indicator marker.

WM058: exact unique print and three Black loyalty; each distinct personal face-up Criminal targeted by an enemy card transaction emits optional pay1-or-counter, excluding activated/triggered abilities and non-targeting mass effects. Source/target/event frozen; turn-scoped declined/paid/countered/no-card receipts prevent repeat consumption. CQ07 and Chance observers may be ordered. XQ15 owner-based Human→Vampire / nonhuman non-Vampire→Slave in every nonblank zone; assets, sealed and hidden cards retain blank rules. Marked secret plans remain attachments and keep private identity through restore; ordinary hidden characters/privates still reject. No region-card time-marker producer admitted by this pilot.

JZ36 native16: printed1 plus sacrificeX personal face-up characters, including attached Bats, before responses. Unpaid private typed cost draft or explicit X0; a single simultaneous death wave with frozen original-region receipts. Fixed paid X survives JZ30 death Forecast continuation and exact high-u64 command replay. Carrier target or original-UID region receives X time, then only target current region is checked for in-place destruction at physical total>=4. Direct region-card time and four-seat projection now admitted only by this closed program; no generic configurable marker op.

XQ18 integration regression: secret plans remain attachment targets for time add/remove; Society carriers use in_play rather than region-only board lookup. Carrier choice and public removal logs keep the anonymous secret-plan name. Ordinary hidden characters remain excluded. Two new four-actor real-command cases fail before the fix; all28 XQ18 cases pass after it, including restore/mutation/privacy guards. No old kernel or frozen candidate changed.

XG16 native22: printed6/Red3/unique/public; own Sun conditionally enables Leader. Optional entry time1 and Prepare time equal to current destroyed-region count. Uses its own finite Prepare opcode with shared typed observation/order/target/resolved-or-cancelled receipts. Effective time includes legal direct attachments; personal recipients gain defense per time, either opposing seat loses defense, ally is unchanged (primary Hegemony printed16/21). All positive defense including Ghoul permanent markers precedes negative time/curses/wounds. Real rescuer activation, aura death/cancellation, Room pause/restore/original-command replay and version-conflict rejection tested; no WASM/public admission.

Explicit AssetByXG18 receipt freezes grant, actual asset and event-time Renown; normalized played card enters ready, own source asset may pay only if originally unexhausted. Hand-only JZ52 ban stays on Hand origin (its own grave-as-hand permission confirms no zone rewrite). Forced actual Renown play emits once per source/event, allows controller ordering with Alpha, uses existing Sun/Moon cancellation on living Societies; reveal/direct entry do not emit.
